newsitem.title: USA: Wells Financial Q4 net up on interest gain.
newsitem.headline: Wells Financial Q4 net up on interest gain.

text.p: Wells Financial Corp said Monday gains in net interest income and non-interest income helped earnings rise by $111,000 in the fourth quarter.

The company reported net income of $481,000 for the period ended Decembr 31, compared to $370,000 one year ago. Net interest income rose to $1.7 million from $1.5 million, while non-interest income climbed to $272,000 from $228,000.
Net interest income was up because of an increase in the size of the loan portfolio, while non-interest income was higher due to increases of the gain on the sale of certain loans.
Wells Financial is a bank holding company.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Monday at 13-5/8.
